[LTIM.1.1.5] Nanosecond precision is normative. Both components of the
`Time` value model carry `Int64` nanosecond precision. The representable
range is approximately ±292 years from the Unix epoch (calendar
≈ 1678–2262), which the runtime must treat as the representable `Time`
range. A `Time` outside it is never a silent wrap. A host call that would
admit one returns `DS_ERR_TIME_RANGE`; an operation in a rule whose result
falls outside it raises a `ComputationError` of kind `NOT_REPRESENTABLE`
([LERR.1.4.10]). Precision and range are properties of the value model.
